title: Mediterranean Chicken Farro Bowls
seoTitle: Mediterranean Chicken Farro Bowls | Firefighter Meal
shortDescription: Herb chicken with farro, cucumber, and hummus for ten
subtitle: Herb chicken with farro, cucumber, and hummus for ten
description: Lemon-oregano chicken roasts and slices over chewy farro with cucumber, tomato, olives, and hummus. A bright, filling bowl that breaks up heavy comfort-food rotations.

steps.title: Cook the farro
steps.instruction: Simmer farro in salted water 25–30 minutes until chewy-tender. Drain and toss with 2 tablespoons olive oil.

steps.title: Roast the chicken
steps.instruction: Coat chicken with lemon juice, oregano, salt, pepper, and 2 tablespoons olive oil. Roast at 425°F 22–25 minutes until internal temp reaches 165°F. Slice. Target oven/smoker temperature: 425°F.

steps.title: Prep the vegetables
steps.instruction: Combine cucumber, tomatoes, and olives. Dress lightly with remaining olive oil and lemon juice.

steps.title: Build the bowl line
steps.instruction: Set out farro, sliced chicken, vegetable mix, hummus, and feta in labeled containers.

steps.title: Assemble and serve
steps.instruction: Portion farro into bowls, top with chicken, vegetables, dollop of hummus, and crumbled feta.

proTips: Pearl farro cooks faster than whole—check package time and adjust.
Pickled red onions add punch without extra prep mid-service.
Grilled zucchini strips use the same oven time as chicken.
tonightSpread: Bowls with warm pita wedges and extra lemon wedges.
Simple tabbouleh on the side if you want more veg volume cheaply.
leftovers: Stuff into pita with extra hummus for quick lunches.
Farro and veg mix makes a cold grain salad the next day.
whyCrewsLikeIt: Farro is nutty, filling, and different from the usual rice line-up. Mediterranean flavors feel light but the portions are hall-sized, not spa-sized.
mealPrepNotes: Cook farro ahead—it holds well. Dice vegetables uniform. Chicken can roast while farro simmers to save time.
